HEADER.TITLE: Companies
HEADER.SUBTITLE: Register client companies and hand over their access key. The client creates its own administrator account by redeeming it in Monkey Platform.

FORM.TITLE: Register company
FORM.SUBTITLE: Create the client company and generate its single-use access key.
FORM.NAME: Legal name
FORM.NAME_HINT: It becomes fixed: the client will see it locked in the onboarding.
FORM.DEDICATED_HINT: Only if the client's own policy requires its data in a separate database. Otherwise its data is isolated in the shared database.
FORM.DEDICATED_WARNING: This decision can't be reverted without migrating the data. Dedicated databases are not available yet: for now registration only supports the shared database.
FORM.INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE: Fill in the required fields before continuing.
FORM.ERROR_TITLE: The company could not be registered
FORM.FRAMEWORKS_HINT: The framework contracted for this company. Only SOC 2 is available today. When declaring its service, the client will see this framework as a fixed option.
FORM.FRAMEWORKS_ERROR: The available frameworks could not be loaded.

KEY.TITLE: Access key
KEY.ONLY_ONCE: Copy the key now: this is the only time it is shown. Monkey only keeps a fingerprint and cannot recover it.
KEY.DELIVER: Send it to the administrative email; the client uses it to create its account in Monkey Platform.
